overview: AI Model Prompt-Injection Testing addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in cross-industry cybersecurity operations. The first proof of value uses retrieval corpora, attack prompts and agent traces. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is critical prompt-injection exploit pass rate, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
